hints.title: Tripartite Substring Decomposition
hints.text: Split the pattern around the two wildcards into sub-patterns a, b, and c.

hints.title: KMP Substring Matching
hints.text: Locate all occurrence indices for a, b, and c across the string using the Knuth-Morris-Pratt algorithm.

hints.title: Binary Search on Bipartite Endpoints
hints.text: For each occurrence of b, binary search the latest valid occurrence of a and the earliest valid occurrence of c to minimize total span.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Finds all occurrences in linear time via KMP and tests middle pattern occurrences using binary search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested substring searches across both wildcards produce quadratic time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: LPS prefix arrays and match index arrays scale linearly with string lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines KMP linear string matching with binary search on index lists.
